title: Compose listener, authenticated RPC sessions and pending calls into the application-owned bridge host
sourceBackedBasis: LWB-R7-109 application-global listener ownership and register-before-launch ordering
LWB-R7-119 pending-call lifecycle and 200 ms timeout
LWB-R7-120 authenticated framed RPC session transport

implementation.start: host canonicalizes an explicit expected-client path, creates one host-global call registry, creates one shared accept loop, and attaches one RPC transport per authenticated session
implementation.routeDispatch: host resolves instanceId or unique literal default route, waits for that accepted session's RPC transport attachment, then sends the recovered call command
implementation.pendingCount: LWBridgeControlPipeHostState.PendingCallCount is the live call-registry count only while RPC transport is active
implementation.stopTransport: atomically removes host transport references, drains outstanding calls with APP_SHUTTING_DOWN, then disposes/cancels the accept loop and sessions
implementation.closeHost: marks application host stopped, drains pending calls, and synchronously disposes the shared accept loop
implementation.transportRestartAfterStop: host remains active after StopRpcTransportAsync; application Close is separate
implementation.rpcAttachmentRace: accepted session exposes a TaskCompletionSource-backed wait so route admission cannot race host call dispatch before RPC transport attachment

expectedClientPathSource.known: original host constructor canonicalizes its third startup argument and stores it as the expected handshake client path at host +0x78..+0x90
expectedClientPathSource.missing: the exact startup-state field/name that supplies that third constructor argument has not yet been source-attributed

initialCommandCounterSeed.missing: the original process-start numeric seed / first emitted suffix is not yet pinned

nextExactGap: Finish the startup alias trace for the host constructor expected-client-path argument and recover the original command-counter initial seed. Only then wire StartRpcTransport into LWBridgeWindow before OverviewLifecycleService/profile launch, enable the already-tested launch binding in normal lifecycle composition, and expose get_status.pending from this live host.
